summary: The International Association of Geophysical Contractors urged that geological and geophysical exploration equipment be exempted from ORV regulations when used for their designed purposes. Their comment was part of a broader group of mining and geophysical industry responses opposing the application of ORV permit requirements to exploration activities. The Department ultimately accepted this position, excepting mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment from the definition of off-road vehicles in the final environmental statement.
summary_quote: International Association of Geophysical Contractors - urged the exemption of geological and geophysical exploration equipment when used for their designed purposes.
